candidates.description: This feature vector represents terminology and concepts associated with the sport of baseball.
This vector activates for adverbs and modifiers that indicate degree, intensity, or quantity across multiple languages.
These tokens represent adverbs of time, frequency, and degree that modify verbs or clauses to specify manner, time, or extent.
This feature vector represents quantifiers and words denoting indefinite quantities or plural amounts across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents terms used for specification, exemplification, or highlighting particular instances.
German auxiliary and modal verbs indicating tense, mood, and voice.
This vector represents the concept of achievement, success, and positive outcomes across multiple languages.
This vector represents the concept of being a professional, contrasted with being an amateur.
This vector represents German grammatical articles, pronouns, and determiners that encode case, gender, and number.
This vector represents team sports played with a ball.
